meta.name: meeting-processor
meta.description: This skill should be used when processing meeting transcripts to auto-detect meeting type (leadgen, partnership, coaching, internal) and extract type-specific structured analysis. Triggers on "process meeting", "analyze meeting", "meeting summary", or after syncing new Fathom/Granola transcripts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动处理会议记录并提取结构化分析
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从会议记录中提取关键信息并分类处理
copy.tagline_en: Automatically process meeting transcripts and extract structured analysis
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to extract key information from meeting transcripts and categorize them

howto.what: 自动分析会议转录文本，识别会议类型（销售、合作、辅导、内部），并提取该类型的关键信息，如承诺事项、痛点、预算等。结果会追加到原文件中。
howto.when: 当你要求处理、分析或总结会议转录，或同步Fathom/Granola转录后触发。

say.text: 帮我处理这份销售会议转录。
say.note: 自动识别为leadgen类型并提取承诺、预算等信息。

say.text: 分析这个合作会议的记录。
总结今天与客户的会议。

howto.what_en: Automatically analyzes meeting transcripts, detects meeting type (leadgen, partnership, coaching, internal), and extracts type-specific structured information such as commitments, pain points, budget, etc. Results are appended to the original file.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to process, analyze, or summarize a meeting transcript, or after syncing new Fathom/Granola transcripts.

say_en.note: Auto-detects as leadgen and extracts commitments, budget, etc.
Works if transcript file is in vault root with YYYYMMDD-*.md naming.
